title: Arithmetic
blurb: Add, subtract, multiply, divide and take square roots of lengths on a number line, with parallels, perpendiculars and a rigid compass ready to hand.

items.title: Two and Three
items.text:
Line $\ell$ is a number line, with $O$ at 0 and $U$ at 1. Construct the points at 2 and 3.

::: Hint
A circle centered at $U$ through $O$ crosses $\ell$ again one unit past $U$.
:::

items.title: Negatives
items.text:
Construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the other side of $O$ from $A$, with $OX = OA$. If $A$ is at $a$, $X$ is at $-a$.

::: Hint
$X$ is as far from $O$ as $A$ is.
:::

items.title: Add
items.text:
Construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, beyond $A$, with $OX = OA + OB$.

::: Hint
Measure $OB$ with Transfer distance, and lay it off from $A$.
:::

items.title: Subtract
items.text:
Construct the point $X$ between $O$ and $A$ with $OX = OA - OB$.

::: Hint
Lay off $OB$ from $A$, back toward $O$.
:::

items.title: Multiply
items.text:
Taking $OU$ as the unit, construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $A$, with $OX = OA \cdot OB$.

::: Hint
Draw another line through $O$ and mark 1 and $OB$ on it. Join the 1 to $A$, and draw the parallel through the other mark: the triangles are similar.
:::

items.title: Reciprocal
items.text:
Taking $OU$ as the unit, construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $A$, with $OX = 1 / OA$.

::: Hint
As for multiplying: mark $OA$ and 1 on another line through $O$, join $OA$’s mark to $U$, and draw the parallel through the 1.
:::

items.title: Divide
items.text:
Taking $OU$ as the unit, construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $A$, with $OX = OA / OB$.

::: Hint
Mark $OB$ and 1 on another line through $O$. Join $OB$’s mark to $A$, and draw the parallel through the 1.
:::

items.title: Thirds
items.text:
Construct the points at $1/3$ and $2/3$, between $O$ and $U$.

::: Hint
Step off three equal lengths along another line through $O$, join the last step to $U$, and draw parallels through the other two.
:::

items.title: Root Two
items.text:
Taking $OU$ as the unit, construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $U$, with $OX = \sqrt 2$.

::: Hint
$\sqrt 2$ is the diagonal of a square with sides of 1.
:::

items.title: Square Root
items.text:
Taking $OU$ as the unit, construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $A$, with $OX = \sqrt{OA}$.

::: Hint
The perpendicular from the hypotenuse of a right triangle to the right angle divides the hypotenuse in two parts, and the square of its length is equal to the product of those parts.
:::

::: Hint
A right angle lying on a circle subtends a diameter.
:::

items.title: Geometric Mean
items.text:
Construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $A$, with $OX = \sqrt{OA \cdot OB}$. This one needs no unit.

::: Hint
As for a square root, with the point at $-OB$ in place of $-1$.
:::

items.title: Hypotenuse
items.text:
Construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $A$, with $OX = \sqrt{OA^2 + OB^2}$.

::: Hint
Stand $OB$ up at right angles to $\ell$ at $O$. Its top is the answer’s distance from $A$.
:::

items.title: Golden Ratio
items.text:
Taking $OU$ as the unit, construct the point $X$ on $\ell$, on the same side of $O$ as $U$, at the golden ratio: $OX = (1 + \sqrt 5) / 2$.

::: Hint
From the midpoint of $OU$, the corner one unit above $U$ is $\sqrt 5 / 2$ away.
:::
